cases.title: 403 Forbidden After SIP Auth - Credential Issue
cases.findings:
**Issue:** INVITE → 407 (auth challenge) → INVITE with creds → 403 Forbidden (no D-code)

**Account:** 1464132c-5812-4bd1-90ff-638121e71f92
**Username:** userimbilalraja14623
**Phone:** +1-585-821-1009
**Source IP:** 204.168.170.153
**Balance:** $7.98 ✅

**Analysis:** Plain 403 (no D-code) = authentication rejected at credential level, not call routing. No CDRs generated (expected — auth failures don't complete). SIP proxy auth logs not in accessible Graylog streams.

**Probable Causes:**
1. Username mismatch (case-sensitive)
2. Missing Outbound Voice Profile on connection
3. SIP client digest auth bug with special characters
4. Connection disabled
cases.notes: Deep dive analysis performed. Sent customer checklist to verify config.
cases.response: Sent configuration verification checklist covering username, OVP, and connection status.

cases.title: WebSocket Media Streaming Timeout - 422 Error 90046
cases.findings:
**Issue:** WebSocket media streaming fails with 422 / error 90046 "Failed to connect to destination".

**Engineering Finding:** WebSocket takes ~4.5s to establish → exceeds call control timeout.

**Customer Rebuttal:** App is warm, handshake completes ~2.5-3s, but 422 returns before handshake finishes.

**Customer Ask:** Increase media streaming timeout for number +3677201027.
cases.notes: ENGDESK: 50333. Sean pushed back to engineering with customer's rebuttal (03-26).
cases.response: Engineering investigating timeout discrepancy. Customer reports handshake completes faster than measured.

cases.title: MS Teams Call Me drops after ~40 seconds (RTP No-Op handling)
cases.findings: **Root Cause:** Customer's AudioCodes SBC sends RTP No-Op packets (PT=120, payload 00000000) as keepalives when no audio is flowing. Carrier (Verizon Wireless) terminates with RTP-RTCP Timeout despite Telnyx forwarding transcoded packets.
cases.notes: VIP account - 2+ months ongoing. Escalated to internal engineering team.
cases.response: Escalated internally. Investigating how B2BUA handles RTP No-Op packets (PT=120).

cases.title: Zambia SIM connectivity - 0 bytes transferred, uplink broken
cases.findings:
**Issue:** SIMs in Zambia connect with good signal but get virtually no data throughput.

**Root Cause:** Bearer path / GTP-U tunnel issue between Sparkle roaming platform and Airtel Zambia.
cases.response: Data analysis confirms systematic uplink failure on Airtel Zambia. Escalating to Sparkle for GTP-U tunnel investigation.
